name: Robinhood Chain

v4PoolManager.note: Contract name PoolManager; deployed via the deterministic CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C. ~$29M TVL, 28.8k txns, ~48 Initialize events per 2000 blocks (2026-09-04). This is the primary launch venue on 4663.

v3Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV3Factory; same deployer (0x9701fb0aDe1E269c8f64Ec0C7b3cfADB31A13A52) as the v2 factory tag. Alternate is the cross-chain canonical address, also tagged. No PoolCreated seen in a small live window — confirm range/address from a real v3 launch before trusting.

v2Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV2Factory; emits PairCreated live (~2 per 2000 blocks, 2026-09-04). LONG's stock-paired pools may land here.

v4Quoter.evidence: quoteExactInputSingle returned a live quote for the CAPY/ETH pool via eth_call (2026-09-05); address also in Uniswap's own v4 deployments doc.
v4Quoter.note: V4Quoter. Used for our own quote-based sell impact (spec §3.3.7 / §3.3.9). v3/v2 sell-impact quotes are not wired (v3 barely used on 4663).

quoteAssets.note: Quote/base assets. Used to tell the new token from the paired asset in a fresh pool, and (later) for liquidity_usd_10m + sell_impact_bps (spec §3.3.7). USDG confirmed from a real v4 Initialize + Blockscout token page (verified). WETH has several deployments on 4663; both verified candidates included.

launchpadVerificationMethod: On-chain only. Do NOT navigate to launchpad marketing sites — several impostor sites on this ecosystem phish for seed phrases. To confirm a pad's factory: find a token believed to be from it (Blockscout token search on this chain, or a listing on defillama.com / dexscreener.com), open that token's creation transaction on Blockscout, read the factory/deployer + the TokenCreated-style event, then put the address in `factories` and set `verified: true` with the tx hash as `evidence`.

launchpads.label: Pons
launchpads.note: Dominant pad by fee share. candidateFactories are the on-chain contracts Blockscout has verified under the name 'PonsFactory' (contract-name tags are submitter-set, so unconfirmed). None emitted logs in a short live window; confirm the live one by tracing a Pons token's creation tx on Blockscout.

launchpads.label: LONG
launchpads.note: Reported to pair new tokens against Robinhood tokenized stocks (e.g. NVDA, HIMS). If so the non-launchpad LP shape means LIQ_IMPAIRED / SELL_IMPAIRED can apply. Confirm the factory from a LONG token's creation tx on Blockscout.

launchpads.label: Hookr.fun
launchpads.note: Reported as a Uniswap v4 hook launchpad. Its pools should show a non-zero hooks address in v4 Initialize — grouping by that hooks contract is one way to attribute. HOOKR token seen at 0x18E674231A58c239Dc7DaeDcffE15Ec3A24cff5c (unverified; check on Blockscout).

launchpads.label: v4.fun (Canopy)
launchpads.note: Canopy / $CNPY. CNPY token seen at 0x701257ee548006e7b60f3abd4bd9b74c65f2d87a (unverified). Confirm the factory from a v4.fun token's creation tx on Blockscout.

launchpads.label: Noxa
launchpads.note: Largely deprecated; kept for backfill coverage (spec §7). Spec §3.2 notes Noxa restricted launch-block buys to the creator. Multiple 'NOXA' tokens exist on-chain; confirm the real pad's factory before trusting attribution.

launchpads.label: Sentry
launchpads.note: Small pad. A token 'sentrylauncher' is on-chain at 0x432e63E00DBC8EFd1109C263dBedCb793609F7Af (unverified) — inspect its deployer on Blockscout as a lead.

launchpads.label: Virtuals Protocol
launchpads.note: AI-agent tokens. VIRTUAL token seen at 0xc6911796042b15d7Fa4F6CDe69e245DdCd3d9c31 (unverified). Virtuals uses a bonding-curve genesis/factory contract that graduates tokens to v4 — find the 4663 deployment by tracing an agent token's creation tx.

launchpads.label: pools.trade
launchpads.note: Reported as a Uniswap-Labs pool-first launch flow. May emit only v4 Initialize with a periphery router as tx.to and no separate factory event — attribute by that router address once identified from a real launch tx.
